name: search_availability
description: MUST call for live availability; never invent slots. For a new booking, omit appointment_id. For rescheduling, first identify the exact old appointment with list_appointments, then ALWAYS pass its appointments[].appointment_id here; the result echoes it so reschedule_appointment can reuse it after confirmation. If the caller asks for the earliest slot and gives no doctor preference, set earliest_only=true and omit practitioner_name. Re-run whenever date, time, doctor, specialty, or branch changes. Omit appointment_date for 'today', 'earliest', or 'as soon as possible'.

appointment_id.description: During rescheduling only: exact appointments[].appointment_id selected from list_appointments. Omit for new bookings.

appointment_type_name.description: Exact appointment type name from get_clinic_catalog, for example Dermatology Consultation.

branch_name.description: Exact branch name from get_clinic_catalog, for example Indiranagar Branch.

department_name.description: Exact department name from get_clinic_catalog, for example Dermatology.

practitioner_name.description: Exact doctor name only when the caller requested a doctor. Omit when they have no preference.

appointment_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in branch timezone. Leave blank for 'today'/'earliest available' -- never guess today's date.

earliest_only.description: True when the caller asks for earliest, soonest, or as soon as possible; otherwise false.
